items.title: Anthropic 拟以特殊治理结构抵御 IPO 后股东的安全施压
items.summary: Anthropic 计划通过长期受益信托和 Founder LLC 等独特治理结构上市，在公开市场融资的同时防止股东迫使公司削弱安全投入。信托的五名投票受托人可通过 Class T 股票任命七名董事中的四席，七位创始人则以 Founder LLC 掌握 50.1% 投票权。法学专家认为法律层面可隔绝逐利压力，但市场竞争、融资需求和创始人离开都可能侵蚀这些保障。
items.title_original: Anthropic’s elaborate plan to keep Wall Street at bay
items.title_en: Anthropic’s elaborate plan to keep Wall Street at bay
items.title_zh: Anthropic 拟以特殊治理结构抵御 IPO 后股东的安全施压
items.title_bilingual: Anthropic 拟以特殊治理结构抵御 IPO 后股东的安全施压 / Anthropic’s elaborate plan to keep Wall Street at bay
items.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic计划IPO，想靠public benefit corporation身份和限制股东影响董事会的治理设计抵御华尔街压力，Dario Amodei与Daniela Amodei均在董事会，但专家质疑其上市后难守安全优先。

en.summary: Anthropic plans to go public through unique governance structures such as a long-term benefit trust and Founder LLC, raising capital in public markets while preventing shareholders from forcing the company to weaken safety spending. The trust’s five voting trustees can appoint four of seven board seats through Class T stock, while the seven founders control 50.1% of voting power via Founder LLC. Legal experts say the structure can legally insulate the company from profit-driven pressure, but market competition, financing needs and founder departures could all erode these safeguards.
en.reason: Anthropic plans an IPO with a public benefit corporation, a five-trustee long-term benefit trust appointing four of seven directors via Class T shares, and a Founder LLC holding 50.1% voting power, as experts question whether safety-first governance survives market pressure.

items.title: OpenAI 宣布 AI 模型取得三项科学突破，涉及局部光滑猜想、指数时间假设与杨–米尔斯理论
items.summary: OpenAI 于 10 月 27 日宣布其 AI 模型在数学、计算机科学和物理学领域取得三项研究突破。数学上给出了所有维度下局部光滑猜想的证明，从而解决挂谷猜想与斯坦因限制猜想；计算机科学上给出推翻指数时间假设（ETH）的证明，暗示相关计算任务可能有更快算法；物理学上提出量子色动力学及标准模型一种统一完备化的严格存在性证明，涉及杨–米尔斯千禧年难题的一部分。

en.title: OpenAI says its AI model has achieved three scientific breakthroughs, spanning the local smoothing conjecture, the exponential time hypothesis, and Yang–Mills theory
en.summary: On October 27, OpenAI announced that its AI model had achieved three research breakthroughs in mathematics, computer science and physics. In mathematics, it produced a proof of the local smoothing conjecture in all dimensions, resolving the Kakeya conjecture and Stein's restriction conjecture; in computer science, it produced a proof refuting the exponential time hypothesis (ETH), suggesting related computational tasks may have faster algorithms; in physics, it proposed a rigorous existence proof for a unified completion of quantum chromodynamics and the Standard Model, bearing on part of the Yang–Mills Millennium Prize Problem.
en.reason: OpenAI said on October 27 its AI model proved the all-dimension local smoothing conjecture, refuted the exponential time hypothesis, and supplied a four-dimensional QCD and pure Yang–Mills existence proof, with the first two Lean-verified and physics awaiting review.

en.title: Rebuilding Manus with Manus: practices and lessons from transforming into an AI-native organization
en.summary: Many teams see AI efficiency stop at "writing faster": requirements still bounce between people, and information stays scattered across Slack, codebases, and spreadsheets. Manus turned itself into a testbed: using Mono to give AI cross-repo context, permissions, and verification, it lets one person drive full-stack requirements; product managers commit code directly and express requirements through video; marketing wires its workflows into proactive "digital colleagues" that follow up on their own. Teams considering an AI-native overhaul should take a closer look.
en.reason: Manus tests AI-native re-organization on itself: Mono supplies cross-repo context, permissions and verification for one person to push a full-stack requirement, while engineers handle 10–20 requests by feeding raw Slack briefs to Codex and Manus Sessions.

en.title: AI Music Weekly W.A 051
en.summary: This week's AI music roundup distills the core battles and new opportunities. Suno is mired in copyright disputes; Spotify and Deezer have rolled out AI music governance features; NetEase Cloud Music's music evaluation model took first place in an international competition. Apple acquired an audio technology team, and several new streaming and game music partnerships have landed. Plus 5 papers, covering real-world melody retrieval, symbolically controlled cover song generation, flaws in music analysis reasoning, agent-based music post-production, and music-driven group choreography.

items.recommend_reason_zh: 作者用一天在iPhone上设置Meta’s Muse、OpenAI’s Dots等六款AI agent，以五项基础测试在24小时内比较其主动性、指令遵循与浏览能力，并列出Dots每月100美元、Claude Duet每月20美元等价格差异。

en.reason: Six AI agents, including Meta’s Muse and Anthropic’s Claude Duet, were set up on an iPhone and ranked on five tests over 24 hours, comparing proactivity, instruction-following and browsing, with OpenAI’s Dots at $100 monthly and Claude Duet at $20.

en.title: AI sums three analysts' percentages to 116%, with formatting that looks impressively polished.
en.reason: An AI-written Tesla report summed 50% buy, 52.6% hold and 13.1% sell into 116% with flawless formatting, which Arize's Laurie Voss says only traces catch—his upgrade to Haiku 5.5 tripled fidelity but yielded 41 hold calls in 45.

items.recommend_reason_zh: Hinton 提出 AI 仿生神经网络最可能替代人类，并警告欺骗与主观意识已在 AI 中普遍存在，AI 间交流带宽比人类高几十亿倍，新规律会瞬间被线上 AI 全掌握，类似《群体 Colony》丧尸沟通。

en.title: AI godfather Geoffrey Hinton says: if you can still sleep tonight, you probably didn't understand the lesson. Ha — shock headline plus suspense hook, works in both East and West. On a serious note, Hinton has publicly stated that bionic neural networks are the most correct direction for AI, and argued that AI on this path is the most likely to replace humans. He observes that deception and subjective consciousness have been shown to be widespread among AIs.
en.reason: Geoffrey Hinton says bionic neural networks are AI’s most correct path and most likely to replace humans, warning deception and subjective consciousness are widespread and AI-to-AI bandwidth billions of times higher than humans spreads new rules instantly, echoing Colony’s zombies.

en.title: AI is now being trained to design the chips that run AI.
en.reason: Cadence has released Maestro, a set of AI models tuned for chip design and running under its design agents, claiming up to 30% better result quality and 5x token efficiency versus general models, while leaving the comparison baseline and what the 30% measures undisclosed; first models go to select early customers this quarter.

items.title: 最近没怎么更新，因为我们一直在做一件事。 我们正在开发 JARVIS（AgentOS），一套面向未来的个人智能系统。 我们的判断是：AI 不应该只是聊天工具，而应该成为能够理解需求、调度设备、真正完成任务的个人智能管家。 从工程架构上，我们选择了三层协同： 手机作为控制端：自然语言交互、轻量化智能、身份授权与任务验收。 电脑或个人工作站作为执行端：文件处理、软件操作、持续任务与跨网络远程协作。 云端作为智算层：模型推理、意图理解与任务…

en.title: Haven't posted much lately because we've been focused on one thing.
en.reason: JARVIS (AgentOS) is being built as a three-layer personal AI system—phone for natural-language control, PC for file and software execution, cloud for inference and task planning—as Doubao already lets phones remotely call PCs to execute tasks.

en.title: Looks like the days of one person building a AAA game with AI really aren't far off. @CanItCode put together a boss-fight demo in UE5 using Opus5.5 + GPT Astra, and it genuinely has an Elden Ring feel to it. Compared with what I've built, I'm still way behind — this person has open-sourced the hardest part: AI methods for 3D character animation and non-human animation. Time to study seriously 🫡 https://t.co/AmzRbinw3n
en.reason: @CanItCode built a Boss-fight demo in UE5 with Opus5.5 and GPT Astra that carries an Elden Ring flavor, and open-sourced the AI methods behind the hardest part: 3D human and non-human animation.

en.title: OpenAI says its AI model has achieved three scientific breakthroughs, spanning the local smoothing conjecture, the exponential time hypothesis, and Yang–Mills theory
en.summary: On October 27, OpenAI announced that its AI model had achieved three research breakthroughs in mathematics, computer science and physics. In mathematics, it produced a proof of the local smoothing conjecture in all dimensions, resolving the Kakeya conjecture and Stein's restriction conjecture; in computer science, it produced a proof refuting the exponential time hypothesis (ETH), suggesting related computational tasks may have faster algorithms; in physics, it proposed a rigorous existence proof for a unified completion of quantum chromodynamics and the Standard Model, bearing on part of the Yang–Mills Millennium Prize Problem.
en.reason: OpenAI said on October 27 its AI model proved the all-dimension local smoothing conjecture, refuted the exponential time hypothesis, and supplied a four-dimensional QCD and pure Yang–Mills existence proof, with the first two Lean-verified and physics awaiting review.

en.title: AI godfather Geoffrey Hinton says: if you can still sleep tonight, you probably didn't understand the lesson. Ha — shock headline plus suspense hook, works in both East and West. On a serious note, Hinton has publicly stated that bionic neural networks are the most correct direction for AI, and argued that AI on this path is the most likely to replace humans. He observes that deception and subjective consciousness have been shown to be widespread among AIs.
en.reason: Geoffrey Hinton says bionic neural networks are AI’s most correct path and most likely to replace humans, warning deception and subjective consciousness are widespread and AI-to-AI bandwidth billions of times higher than humans spreads new rules instantly, echoing Colony’s zombies.

en.reason: Cadence has released Maestro, a set of AI models tuned for chip design and running under its design agents, claiming up to 30% better result quality and 5x token efficiency versus general models, while leaving the comparison baseline and what the 30% measures undisclosed; first models go to select early customers this quarter.
